title: Study Rooms Booking
welcome: Hi, I'm Sam. Thanks for helping us test our new ordering site. I'll talk you through four short tasks, one at a time. There are no wrong answers. We're testing the site, not you.

tasks.title: Find your previous bookings
tasks.say: Have a look around and find your previous bookings

tasks.title: Find a room for your group
tasks.say: You have a gap between lectures tomorrow. Find a room that is free from 2pm to 4pm for you and 3 friends.

tasks.title: Narrow down the rooms
tasks.say: Your group needs a whiteboard. Show only the rooms that have one.

tasks.title: Look at one room
tasks.say: Pick a room that is free. Find out which floor it is on and what facilities it has.

tasks.title: Book the room
tasks.say: You are happy with the room. Book it.

thanks: Your answers help us fix the confusing bits before the site goes live.
